beats.say: 520 million copies: Tetris remains the biggest selling game in history by a huge margin.
At number ten, Super Mario Bros, with 58 million units sold, really started the gaming craze.
Skyrim sits at eight with 65 million, while the creative Terraria hits 70 million at seven.
PUBG reaches 75 million at six, just behind the popular Mario Kart 8 at 79.99 million.
Wii Sports claims fourth place with 82.9 million, and Red Dead Redemption 2 takes third place.
Grand Theft Auto V is second with 230 million, while Minecraft and Tetris share the top spot.
These simple titles prove that gameplay often beats graphics. Which game on this list do you still play today?
